title: 第21章 抓捕怨灵

第21章 抓捕怨灵-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜坐在小年轻的椅子上，等了约莫两分钟，估摸着两人已经跑到一楼了，这才往楼上走去。

临走前，他还好心的顺手帮两人关上了办公室的门。

至于明天，会不会再多一条鼎鑫大厦深夜闹鬼、吓哭加班打工人的新闻，那就不关他的事了。

吴姜刚走到三十三楼的楼梯转角，身后突然传来一阵凌厉的风声。

一股极致冰冷的阴气，带着毁天灭地的戾气，猛地从身后袭来，速度快得惊人，直逼他的后心。

吴姜反应极快，几乎是下意识地侧身躲闪，同时手腕一翻，手中的斩魂剑反手向后一挥，“锵——”的一声脆响，斩魂剑精准撞上阴气凝聚而成的利爪，刺耳的金属碰撞声在空旷的走廊里回荡，一股强大的冲击力顺着剑身传来，让他连连后退两步，脚下踉跄了一下，才勉强稳住身形。

吴姜心中暗道：果然够凶！这怨灵的实力，就算比不上王家那只厉鬼，但其凶戾程度，却有过之而无不及。

他抬眼望去，只见走廊尽头，站着一个身穿职业装的女人，长发凌乱地披散着，遮住了大半张脸，只露出一双布满血丝、写满怨毒和戾气的眼睛。

正是他此次要抓捕的目标，怨灵钟晓芹。

吴姜定了定神，清了清嗓子，开口念起了惯例的开场白：“钟晓芹，你阳寿已尽，又因怨气滔天残害无辜，触犯阴律，吾乃地府勾魂司鬼差吴姜，今日特来将你捉拿归案，押赴地府受审，还不速速束手就擒！”

吴姜也没有等女鬼回话，他心里清楚，眼前这只怨灵已经手上沾了三条人命，戾气滔天，指望她乖乖束手就擒，根本不可能。

话音刚落，手中的勾魂索就飞了出去。

与此同时，他指尖凝出幽冥鬼火，术法阴火灼烧，一同朝着女鬼烧去。

女鬼也不示弱，指甲飞涨，这就是她的武器，朝着吴姜扑了过去。

一人一怨灵，瞬间在空旷的走廊里斗在了一起。

有过抓捕厉鬼经验的吴姜，早已不是当初那个手忙脚乱的新手，招式愈发娴熟，魂力运转流畅，每一招每一式，都精准地朝着怨灵的弱点攻去。

不得不说，手上沾了人命的怨灵，虽然还是比不上王家那女鬼的实力，但是凶厉程度却是犹有过之。

Wu Jiang sat on the young man's chair and waited for about two minutes. He estimated that the two of them had reached the first floor, and then walked upstairs.

Before leaving, he kindly closed the office door for the two of them.

As for tomorrow, whether there will be another piece of news about Dingxin Building being haunted late at night and making workers cry and beat overtime workers, that is none of his business.

Wu Jiang had just reached the corner of the stairs on the 33rd floor when a sharp wind suddenly came from behind him.

An extremely cold Yin Qi, carrying a world-destroying ferocity, suddenly struck from behind, at an alarming speed, hitting his back.

Wu Jiang reacted very quickly, dodging sideways almost subconsciously. At the same time, he flipped his wrist and swung the Soul-Slaying Sword backhand with his backhand. With a crisp sound of "Clang--", the Soul-Slaying Sword accurately hit the claws formed by the condensed Yin Qi. The harsh sound of metal collision echoed in the empty corridor. A powerful impact came along the sword, causing him to take two steps back. He staggered a little before he managed to steady himself.

Wu Jiang thought to himself: It is indeed fierce!Even if the strength of this resentful spirit is not as good as that of the Wang family, its ferocity is even greater.

He looked up and saw a woman in professional attire standing at the end of the corridor. Her long hair was messy and disheveled, covering most of her face, revealing only a pair of bloodshot eyes filled with resentment and anger.

It was the target he wanted to capture this time, the resentful spirit Zhong Xiaoqin.

Wu Jiang calmed down, cleared his throat, and recited the customary opening remarks: "Zhong Xiaoqin, your yang life has expired, and you have killed innocent people because of your grievances, violating the laws of the yin. I am Wu Jiang, the ghost of the seduction department of the underworld. I am here today to capture you and bring you to justice. I will take you to the underworld for trial. Why don't you just surrender quickly!"

Wu Jiang did not wait for the female ghost to reply. He knew in his heart that the resentful spirit in front of him had already killed three people on its hands and was so violent that it was impossible to expect her to just surrender.

As soon as he finished speaking, the hook in his hand flew out.

At the same time, ghost fire condensed from his fingertips, and the Yin Fire of the spell burned towards the female ghost.

The female ghost didn't show any weakness, her fingernails shot up, which were her weapons, and she rushed towards Wu Jiang.

One person and one resentful spirit instantly fought together in the empty corridor.

Wu Jiang, who has experience in catching evil ghosts, is no longer the busy novice he was at the beginning. He has become more proficient in his moves, and his soul power is flowing smoothly. Every move and every move is aimed at the weak points of the resentful ghosts accurately.

It has to be said that although the resentful spirit with human life on its hands is still not as strong as the female ghost of the Wang family, it is still more ferocious.
